title: Observation finish button hotfix
details: Fixes the Android observation fault where the camera stops but Finish LO stays on screen and never completes
If Android fails to send the recorder stop event, Milos now releases the clip automatically after a short safety timeout and continues to the feedback screen
The Finish control now shows Saving clip while Milos finalises the recording and ignores repeated taps during that process
The existing Competent and More required decisions, stored video chunks and observation workflow are otherwise unchanged
